ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT ("Agreement") dated as of August /, 2004, between Allen/Orchard, LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an office at c/o S & H Equities, 98 Cutter Mill Road, Great Neck, New York { 2j ("Transferor") and Allen Realty Associates NY LLC, 2050 Center Avenue, Fort Lee, New Jersey 07?Y ("Transferee"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Transferor is the owner of certain land in the City of New York ("Transferor's Land") and the buildings and improvements located thereon being Block 417, Lots 51 and 76 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, New York County and more particularly described in Schedule A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (together with Transferor's Land, "Transferor's Property"); and WHEREAS,TransfereeistheownerofcertainlandsintheCityofNewYork thereon, commonly known as 183, 185, and 187 Orchard Street, New York, New York, being Block 417, Lots 61, 62, and 63 on the Tax Map of the City of New York ("Transferee's Existing Building"), and as more particularly described in Schedule B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (together with Transferee's Land, "Transferee's Property"); and WHEREAS, Transferee proposes to demolish, reconstruct and/or alter and construct a new building, or additions to the buildings and improvements currently on Transferee's Land and, possibly, on other adjacent parcels (collectively, "Transferee's Building"); and WHEREAS, it is anticipated that Transferee's Building will contain more Floor Area ("Floor Area"),as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution of the City of NewYork, effective as of December 15,1961,as amended from time to time ("Zoning Resolution"), than is now available for use in respect to Transferee's Property under the Floor Area Ratio Limitation contained in the present Zoning Resolution, with the result that Transferee desires to utilize the procedure available under the Zoning Resolution for combining Transferee's Property, and, Zoning Resolution for the purpose of determining compliance by Transferee's Building with such limitation, which procedure will make available to Transferee for such purpose 57,895 square feet of the unused Floor Area attributable to the Transferor's Property, and the development rights associated with such unused Floor Area ("Excess Floor Area Development Rights");
